body: Chief (align overlap note): claude-storymodel4s-m1 now holds align GateProofSuite/PopulationSuite/WorkedExampleSuite/PropertySuite/FeaturesIntegrationSuite/AnnaFixture for the P0-3 repair; codex-storyatlas-root holds cost.scala/source.scala for P1-3.
